name: Leinore
description: A baker-like caretaker of her village in Kessig chosen by the Dawnhart Coven to oversee the Harvesttide festivities, who frees her sister from a cursed mask.

timeline.summary: Leinore and Sinnia find a dead snake in a cold campfire that seems to move, while the festival of Harvesttide is meant to bring hope but more people go missing.
timeline.quote: Leinore found the dead snake mixed in the ashes of a campfire gone cold hours ago.

timeline.summary: At an abandoned tent of a missing family, Sinnia finds a scale-crusted golden mask and tries it on over Leinore's objections.
timeline.quote: Sinnia took off her fox mask and tried on the new one, causing Leinore to flinch.

timeline.summary: At the Celestus Leinore sees that the witches are binding human teeth into necklaces for the festivalgoers, and Katilda calls them werewolf teeth.
timeline.quote: "They are teeth," she said plainly. "Werewolf teeth."

timeline.summary: Jagger accuses the witches of stealing from the missing villagers and the crowd turns angry.
timeline.quote: "Did you steal those from the missing villagers?"

timeline.summary: Sinnia, wearing the mask, calms the crowd with a speech and the villagers shout to bring back the light and gather around her.
That night Sinnia, still masked, tells Leinore that the Coiled One has spoken to her and is surfacing.
timeline.quote: The Coiled One has spoken to me today, sister.

timeline.summary: Over the next days Sinnia replaces Leinore as the Sovereign of Harvesttide and makes villagers cough up small snakes while the crowd rejoices.
timeline.quote: Sinnia had replaced Leinore as the Sovereign of Harvesttide in the eyes of the festivalgoers.

timeline.summary: Leinore pretends to sleep and then follows Sinnia into the forest at night.
timeline.quote: Leinore followed Sinnia into the night.

timeline.summary: Leinore sees Sinnia drag an unconscious man to a giant egg that opens and swallows him, and notices a woman watching from the shadows.
timeline.quote: To Leinore's horror, she watched her sister push the unconscious man into it.

timeline.summary: Katilda grabs Leinore and aims her staff at Sinnia, but Leinore bites her hand and ruins the shot.
timeline.quote: Without thinking, Leinore bit down on Katilda's hand.

timeline.summary: Katilda reveals that the woman is Saryth, whose power lies in the mask, and that Sinnia is consumed by it.
timeline.quote: "Saryth isn't the one wearing the mask," Katilda said, picking up her staff.

timeline.summary: The ground splits and the Coiled One begins to rise from a chasm as Saryth screams that it is time and wounds Katilda.
Katilda urges Leinore to destroy Sinnia, but Leinore insists on trying to take the mask off and Katilda agrees to distract Saryth.
timeline.quote: "Don't you dare touch my sister. I'll get the mask off her."

timeline.summary: Sinnia whispers for help and Leinore tears the fused mask off her face as the Coiled One bends to swallow them.
timeline.quote: Without thinking she started to pull as hard as she could.

timeline.summary: With the mask gone the Coiled One bellows and retreats into the earth, pulling the eggs down with it.
timeline.quote: With one last hiss, the Coiled One dragged its body to the depths of the earth

timeline.summary: Leinore, Sinnia and Katilda return to the settlement, where freed festivalgoers wander dazed and remember nothing, though many remain missing.
timeline.quote: Soon, they found people stumbling around, wondering among themselves how they got there and which day of the festival it was.

relations.quote: Her little sister always teased her with kindness.

relations.note: They work together against Saryth despite their disagreement.
relations.quote: "Let me try. You have to distract Saryth for me."

pages_say.description: A baker-like caretaker of her village in Kessig chosen by the Dawnhart Coven to oversee the Harvesttide festivities, who frees her sister from a cursed mask.
